title: Streaming app opening and browsing
slide_intent: Carry identity from loading into content so a viewer does not lose orientation when an interface becomes useful.
strategic_value: The same green 4 at launch and in the browsing header can connect streaming to the broadcaster.
demonstration: A phone mockup opens with a rotating green mark, reveals an It’s a Sin feature and changes to Taskmaster above a trending row.
practical_value: Compare the launch signature with its quieter role after programme content appears.

content_islands.name: Phone
content_islands.spec: Keep the diagonal handset on its pale surface throughout.

content_islands.name: Launch and browse sequence
content_islands.spec: Replace the centered logo with the content interface, preserving a smaller 4 near the top.

reference_purposes.Application: The video demonstrates a branded app launch followed by programme browsing.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case study explains that renaming the player Channel 4 connects streaming clearly to the masterbrand.
